🔥 The fire settles. Sari has been quiet all evening, and now everyone knows why. "Lockpick — I put it down today." "It sits up. Its hands move too fast to follow. Something you own is suddenly in its hands." "Cornered, it shows its teeth. It fights second — but it fights." A beat of silence, then the questions come all at once. Leonard says "Tell me you didn't go alone." Carlos says quietly "And you're still standing." Someone at the edge of the light says what everyone's thinking: "So — what are we calling it?"

🔥 The fire settles. Sari has been quiet all evening, and now everyone knows why. "White Noise — I put it down today." "The heron is gone. No — it's there. It was always there. You just couldn't see it until it moved." "You blink. It is somewhere else. You didn't see it move." A beat of silence, then the questions come all at once. Nikolai asks "Did it look at you? Before?" Kwame breathes "We've been walking past those." Someone at the edge of the light says what everyone's thinking: "So — what are we calling it?"

Kwame leans in, voice low. "Here's what we figured out about White Noise. Step off the line. When it unfolds, SIDESTEP — it commits to the line and can't correct. Watch the water, not the bird: it strikes where you were standing, never where you are."
